t: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet: Rise to the Challenge
d: Dr. Jeff attempts to diagnose a dog's devastating mystery illness  vet tech Hector's daughter is tasked with caring for a mother dog and her seven pups  Dr. Baier volunteers to help find new homes for rescued rabbits.

Mysterious and bizarre alien sharks lurk far beneath the waves in deep waters where researchers are on a quest to make first contact  pursuing the elusive frilled shark, sleeper shark and cookie cutter shark brings even more unexpected encounters.

t: Wild Frank in Australia: Marsupial Encounters
d: Frank is in the Australian jungle with the Wombat. A marsupial that resembles a giant hamster and can weigh up to 26 kilos. Frank approaches stealthily, as it is a very elusive animal and can reach 40 km / h.

t: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Irwin African Adventure
d: The Irwins travel to South Africa, where Terri helps release a wild leopard  Bindi learns from the all-female anti-poaching squad, The Black Mambas  Robert attempts to photograph Africa's big five game animals.

When Kip the young silver langur falls ill, he must be nursed back to health  Cora, the white-naped crane chick, is relocated and introduced to her potential mate  giraffes Jigsaw and Zizi are paired for breeding.

t: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Deadliest Moments
d: In a making-of special, Dave Salmoni reveals the hardship and dangers - not to mention broken equipment - he and his team had to battle during filming the series.
Lumi and Kacy are missing  a former sanctuary resident tries to beg food from humans at an area nature reserve restaurant.
